metadata.name: MedSync Consultation System
metadata.description: Dynamic consultation system for doctors and clinics. Supports parent consultation series, child consultation sessions, specialty-specific forms, consultation history, lab orders, prescriptions, documents, and doctor-specific field preferences.

recommended_names.consultation_series: Parent consultation / parent case / treatment series
recommended_names.consultations: Each real consultation session, including initial consultation and follow-ups

core_concept.rule: The first consultation opens a consultation_series. Every next consultation is a child session linked to the same series_id and parent_consultation_id.

note: Canonical workspace/backend schema snapshot created from the user-provided JSON payload on 2026-05-27. Keep this file in sync with API and DB migration changes.
